nodes.label: B2B Backlink Intelligence Report (Foundation Inc., March 2026)
nodes.author: Foundation Inc.
nodes.rationale: Analyzes 12,154 content pages across 24 B2B brands / 11 verticals / 2,418,311 referring domains to determine which content formats earn backlinks most efficiently, arguing B2B brands overinvest in Thought Leadership and underinvest in Statistics, Glossary, and How-To content.

nodes.label: Ross Simmonds (Founder and CEO, Foundation Inc.)
Statistics / Data Roundup (content type)
nodes.rationale: Highest-leverage B2B content format: 4.25x efficiency score, 1.0% of pages but 4.1% of referring domains, 42.1% hit 1,000+ RD, 5.3% fail rate.

nodes.label: Glossary / Definition (content type)
nodes.rationale: 1.47x efficiency, consistent returns across all brand authority tiers, 23.8% fail rate, 5.6% breakout rate.

nodes.label: Interactive Tool / Calculator (content type)
nodes.rationale: 1.38x efficiency, low fail rate, Tier 2 format.

nodes.label: How-To / Tutorial (content type)
nodes.rationale: 1.36x efficiency, largest under-invested gap (+4.4 pp), success driven by audience job-to-be-done rather than product proximity.

nodes.label: Best Of / Listicle / Comparison (content type)
nodes.rationale: 1.08x efficiency; numbers in title lift performance 1.31x.

nodes.label: Blog Post (General) (content type)
nodes.rationale: 1.02x efficiency; numbers in title lift performance 1.75x, largest title-number uplift of any format.

nodes.label: Developer Docs / Education Hub (content type)
nodes.rationale: 1.00x efficiency but most underrepresented high-floor format: 74.5% reach 200+ RD, only 2.0% fail rate, just 1.5% of all pages.

nodes.label: Original Research / Report (content type)
nodes.rationale: 0.80x efficiency, bimodal distribution: 49.6% fail rate overall but the 72.0% that reach 200+ RD perform at elite levels when they have topic breadth, annual cadence, and primary data.

nodes.label: Thought Leadership / Insight (content type)
nodes.rationale: 0.74x efficiency, Tier 4 structural underperformer: 37.0% of all pages but only 27.5% of referring domains (-9.5pp, the single largest misallocation), 44.8% fail rate; works only for institutionally authoritative management-consulting brands.

nodes.label: Efficiency Score metric (RD share / page share)
Fail Rate metric (% pages earning <50 RD)
Cloudflare (Security/Infrastructure)
nodes.rationale: Highest median RD/page (3,516) of all 24 brands, attributed to years of high-quality developer content making it a primary reference source.

nodes.label: Bain (Management Consulting)
nodes.rationale: High page count (2,446) but low median RD (19) - cited as a failure-mode example of overreliance on Thought Leadership/blog content at an emerging authority level.

nodes.label: Nextiva (Communications SaaS)
nodes.rationale: Cited as a failure-mode example: high page count (690), low median RD (20), heavy reliance on Thought Leadership.
